correctness.rationale: All six distinct points have affine span dimension 2–5. The exact cyclotomic identity gives a Fourier zero iff each ternary phase occurs twice. Character fibers scale ranks by 3^(d-r). The complete 10-orbit exact finite certificate and a separate 26-character enumeration both return the same 296010-subset rank census in dimension three. The one-relation phase-word argument covers every affine dimension-four configuration and has exactly 106 relation classes; dimension five is an affine simplex with precisely 30 balanced phase assignments. Affine-flat counts with exact GL4/GL5 factors sum to C(3^d,6), verified at d=2..8 and proved for all d by unique span counting. The rigidity and all eight strata follow from the local classification. Three full programs replayed successfully.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete coefficient-constrained Fourier-support classification in all dimensions, not an arbitrary slice or mere implementation. Exact geometry determines which loss levels occur, and every possible convolution rank has a closed population formula. The minimum one-third recoverable character dimension is sharp with rigid plane-minus-line extremizers; higher-dimensional dependence types create genuinely new 17/27 and 71/81 ranks. These quantify recoverable dimensions of every six-site ternary convolution mask and provide useful test cases for finite uncertainty and sensing theory. No general downstream theorem is asserted as necessary for value.
